_doc: The pollution kinds of this planet (design spec section 2; systems/pollution.gd). Which city holds which kinds is the `pollution` list of each city in districts.json; this table says what each kind is. A new kind is a new entry here and its id in a city's list: no code. base: the id of the base kind, the loose junk every land hex holds (its share of a hex is what the other kinds leave). default_kinds: the kinds of hexes outside every city (open ground) and of a city that lists none. kinds.<id>: name (shown, translated). work: how the kind is cleared: 'pieces' = loose junk Lumi and cleaner robots scoop (the base kind); 'heavy' = a few big pieces from `models`, scooped like any piece once the gate is met; 'float' = the floating waste of a water hex (the whole hex is this kind); 'held' = no pieces: Lumi takes it with `tool`, robots of `robot_roles` with theirs, and scooping cannot touch it. spawn: on ('land' or 'water'), density (share of the city's hexes of that ground that hold the kind, 0..1), cluster (0 = scattered evenly, 1 = in patches about 60 m across; with patches the density is only about right), min_ring (the kind keeps this many rings away from the city's site), share (the kind's share of the hex's waste, hex_work in districts.json; never under 0.08 so it cannot sweep away untouched, and all kinds beside the base kind never take more than 0.9 of a hex), pieces (heavy only: big pieces on an untouched hex). models (heavy only): {id, vol, w, lie} as in junk.json; vol 2.5 and up is the large size class, which Lift Strength 2 lifts. junk_type: the junk.json type the waste counts as in Lumi's chest and bales. color (held only): the colour of what streams into the chest. gate: what Lumi needs to work the kind at all: {stat, min} = an upgrade stat at this value or more, {flag} = a progress flag (seeds_unlocked = the garden tools: planter and watering can), {module} = a rig module that must be fitted (rigs.json; [M3-08] every kind beside litter is gated by its city's tool: the Plate Cutter for wrecks, the Skim Skirt for slick, the Mist Scrubber for smog, the Soil Doser for blight; the Cutter and the Skirt bring the lift and the hover they need, so no upgrade bought in the first city opens a later city's kind). All that are given must hold. tool (held only): the tool Lumi clears it with, 'water' (the watering can: misting) or 'plant' (the planter: cleansing plants). hand_factor (held only): Lumi's rate on the kind against her scoop rate (units a second = hand_factor x scoop pulse volume x scoop rate). tool_use_per_unit (held only): how much of the tool's own stock one unit takes (water from the can's tank of plants.json water_tank). cost (held only): {currency, per_hex, prompt}: clearing the kind from one whole hex costs per_hex of the currency, spent a whole unit at a time as the work adds up; at least one must be in hand to start; prompt is the toast when there is none. robot_roles: the robot roles (robots.json `role`) that may work the kind: cleaners scoop pieces, skimmers the lakes, the watering robot mists and the planting robot sets cleansing plants. robot_units (held only): units of the kind one robot action takes (an action is 3 s at work_rate 1). yield: cubes = the kind's weight in a hex's cube value (a hex is worth its city's hex_cubes whatever it holds; a unit of a kind pays its share times this over the hex's average, so the weights only move value between kinds on one hex); parts = multiplier on the chance of a part worth stripping from Lumi's take. hint: how to work the kind, shown on the hex readout when Lumi has the tool. prompt: what it needs, shown on the readout and over the piece when she has not. Numbers follow the accepted proposal (tools/pace_sim/proposals/planet1/pollution.json: hand factors 0.8 to 0.9, cube yields 0.9 to 1.1, blight 0.35 seeds a hex); spawn shares and densities are first values for the balance pass (M3-12). [M3-05] mastery (design spec section 3; systems/mastery.gd, core/mastery_rules.gd): each kind has a mastery level for the planet, filled only by Lumi's own work on that kind. max_level: the top level. growth: a level needs this many times the units of the level before (level L is held at mastery_level1_units x growth^(L-1) units in all; 1.78 puts level 5 at about ten times level 1, so about 2 minutes of hand work for the first level and about 20 for the fifth). hand_bonus_per_level: Lumi's own rate on a kind is 1 + this x level. legacy_credit: a save from before mastery is given this share of the waste of its clean hexes as hand work, kind by kind (and never less than level 1 in a kind its robots already work). hand_share: the simulators' rule for Lumi's share of all cleaning by volume: `min` is required in the first `cities` cities (docs/DECISIONS.md, Nov 10: the old 30% rule was dropped for a crew of 100 to 200) and `target` is the old rule, reported city by city so the owner can judge it. kinds.<id>.mastery_level1_units: units of the kind Lumi clears by hand for level 1 (the accepted proposal's numbers: they rise with each city's heavier hexes and Lumi's faster hands, so the first level stays about two minutes of work). kinds.<id>.mastery_per_unit: mastery one unit of the kind gives (1.0 everywhere on this planet). How fast robots work a kind at each level is in robots.json (mastery_speed, proximity). mastery.level_reward: what each mastery level Lumi gains pays (systems/mastery_rewards.gd; the rewards of the parked Lumi Level, moved here with the same numbers in task M3-13). Every level in any kind is one step; step = all mastery levels + 1. A step pays about cube_secs of current income, at least min_cubes_per_step x step and at most max(cap_cubes_base x step^1.5, cap_earned_frac x lifetime cubes); every seeds_every-th step also pays seeds + seeds_per_10_steps x (step / 10) seeds once the garden is open.
